items.title: Trump threatens new Canada tariffs over fires sending 'filthy' air into US cities
items.description: Canadian leader Mark Carney says both the US and Canada have an equal responsibility to fight climate change, which experts say are worsening wildfire conditions.

items.title: Many Ukrainian soldiers outraged over removal of defence minister, troops tell BBC
items.description: Protests erupted in Ukraine on Thursday after Mykhailo Fedorov's removal - and now soldiers are also criticising the move.

items.description: India's first space-tech unicorn Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched Vikram-1 on Saturday.

items.description: The comments could further fuel the row over the incident, which has seen Downing Street back calls for Fifa to investigate.

items.title: One anti-war critic fined, another held as Russia clamps down on dissent
items.description: While Boris Nadezhdin is barred from running for parliament, blogger Ilya Remeslo is remanded in custody.

items.title: Indian activist on hunger strike for 20 days forcibly taken to hospital
items.description: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke has now begun an indefinite fast in Sonam Wangchuk's place.

items.title: EU proposes slowing down cuts to carbon emissions for businesses
items.description: Under the proposals, the EU plans to relax its emissions trading system to give companies more time to reduce their carbon output.

items.title: Magnitude 7.3 earthquake quake strikes off Mexico coast
items.description: The US Tsunami Warning Center has recorded waves 0.3m (1.1 feet) high in Puerto Madero and Chiapas in Mexico after the quake.

items.title: Air conditioner sparked deadly blaze at children's orphanage - police
items.description: Eleven people, including children, died in the fire that also injured 19 others.
